purpose.title: 1. Purpose
purpose.p1: These Terms of Service (hereafter "Terms") define the terms and conditions of use of the MakerFlow application, available online.
purpose.p2: MakerFlow is an application designed for content creators. It lets you connect social media accounts (Instagram, YouTube), view performance analytics and write scripts for your content.
purpose.p3: Using MakerFlow implies full and complete acceptance of these Terms. If you do not accept these conditions, please do not use the application.

access.title: 2. Access and registration
access.intro: Access to MakerFlow requires the creation of a user account. When registering, you must provide accurate and up-to-date information.
items: Use of MakerFlow is reserved for people aged 16 or over
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided when registering
MakerFlow reserves the right to refuse or suspend access to any user not complying with these Terms

services.title: 3. Description of services
items: Connection of Instagram and YouTube accounts via the OAuth protocol to collect performance analytics
Analytics dashboard to visualize the performance of your posts
Writing and organizing scripts for your content
services.outro: MakerFlow reserves the right to evolve, modify or remove certain features at any time, without prior notice.

billing.title: 4. Subscriptions and payments
billing.intro: MakerFlow offers different paid subscription plans with various features and usage limits. Details of the offers (prices, included credits, limits) can be viewed from the application.
items: Payments are managed by Stripe, a secure payment provider. MakerFlow does not store any banking data
Subscriptions are automatically renewed at each billing period, unless previously cancelled by the user
You can cancel your subscription at any time from the application settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period
In case of cancellation, you retain access to paid features until the end of the period already paid for
Each subscription includes a number of monthly credits. Additional credit top-ups can be purchased separately
billing.outro: MakerFlow reserves the right to change subscription pricing and conditions. Users will be informed of any modification before the next renewal.

account.title: 5. User account
account.intro: You are entirely responsible for the security of your account and the confidentiality of your login credentials.
account.item1: You must not share your credentials with third parties
account.item2: Any activity carried out from your account is deemed to have been performed by you
account.item3: In case of suspicion of unauthorized use of your account, you must notify us immediately at <contactLink>contact@maker-flow.com</contactLink>

Not use the application for unlawful, fraudulent purposes or purposes infringing the rights of third parties
Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to MakerFlow's systems or data
Not disrupt the normal operation of the application
Comply with the terms of use of connected third-party platforms (Instagram, YouTube)

intellectualProperty.p2: You retain all rights over the content you create through the application (scripts). MakerFlow does not claim any ownership rights over your content.

personalData.p1: MakerFlow collects and processes personal data as part of its operation. The details of the collection, use and protection of your data are described in our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
